scope: Read-only audit of the specified 20 families; originals and all authoring/native/catalog state unchanged.

families.authored_coordinate_contract: Assembly metre XYZ coordinates; Z vertical; exact part pivots equal geometric cell minimum, not ground/contact or facing anchors.
families.split_policy: Sparse geometric corridors, family-specific corner/facade/core regions and vertical tiers. Tiers are authoring subdivisions, not asserted architectural floor measurements.
families.assembly_policy: Exact original reconstruction with matched adjacency and recorded local pivots. Arbitrary repeats, cross-family substitution and arbitrary geographic footprints are not validated.
